development_label: DEVELOPMENT / TEST LEAGUE. This league is run to test the simulation as it is built. Its teams, players, scores and history are not final and may be reset whenever the rules or the simulation change.

notices.text: DEVELOPMENT / TEST LEAGUE. This league is run to test the simulation as it is built. Its teams, players, scores and history are not final and may be reset whenever the rules or the simulation change.
Results appear when the league commits an event: a whole week's games show together once the week has been played. The real-time clock that reveals each game at its own kickoff is not built yet.
Players' ratings, coaches' views and club deliberations are not published. Rosters show only public facts.
Not built yet: the live game view and play-by-play, player and team statistics, box scores, the draft pages, a transactions feed, awards and halls, and the media coverage.
History covers only the seasons played in this development league so far. Earlier Diamond Coronation scores are not yet recorded in the league's season reports, so only the latest season shows one.
The Ambassador Bowl rosters and result appear after the game. How they were chosen is not published.
Some rule details still await the owner's ruling; the Rules page lists only what is approved.
The official DFL map has not been added to this preview yet.
